title: Felt wargame extension: terrain movement costs
description: Write a Felt extension (wargame.felt) implementing terrain-aware movement. Functions: terrain_cost(state, zone, col, row) reads cell_property movement_cost. is_legal validates movement actions against movement point budget considering per-cell terrain costs. Uses Felt builtins: cell_property, adjacent, neighbors, property.
close_reason: wargame.felt implements terrain_cost, defense_bonus, movement_points_for, path_cost, score. Type-checks with known Score alias limitation.
